Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring disclosure of information regarding work done for the state.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring disclosure of information regardingwork done for the state of Washington; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends to changerequirements related to disclosure of information about state contractsthat are performed, in whole or in part, at locations outside theUnited States.
